notes: Pinned by the FTLR-0 SCIP pilot (#299). scip-clang v0.4.0 bundles its own LLVM/Clang; no system clang is used. Version drift is a documented pilot limitation: the SCIP output shape (cxx symbol scheme, no SymbolInformation.kind, no enclosing_range) is validated in scripts/formal/scip_index.py against this exact version. scripts/formal/bootstrap-scip-clang.sh refuses to install a binary whose sha256 differs from this file (fail-closed).
